measurement_contract.marketing: platform/approved asset_id + utm_campaign + first-party qualified sessions
measurement_contract.cta_click: independent, NOT a confirmed subscriber or sale
measurement_contract.affiliate_click: only after authorized outbound link, NOT a commission
measurement_contract.confirmed_paid_order: merchant/Payhip provider independently reports paid transaction
measurement_contract.settled_commission: cleared earnings report, adjusted for refunds, reversals and fees
measurement_contract.net_formula: 1000 * (settled gross received - verified refunds - fees - reversals) / independently qualified sessions
